title: ISic002104. Funerary stele for Hegesippos
body:
Text encoding: Jonathan Prag; edition source: https://www.zotero.org/groups/382445/items/LHNEVHEN
1Ͱε̄γέ̄σιπός ἐ̄μ   ←
2ι τὺ Βύλιος   →

Text encoding: Jonathan Prag; edition source: https://www.zotero.org/groups/382445/items/LHNEVHEN
1ͰΕ̄ΓΕ̄ΣΙΠΟΣΕ̄Μ   ←
2ΙΤΥΒΥΛΙΟΣ   →

Facsimile Images

Apparatus criticus

  • Text of Boffa

English translation

Jonathan Prag

I am Hegesipos, (son) of Bulis

Italian translation

https://www.zotero.org/groups/382445/items/LHNEVHEN

Hegesippos sono, (figlio) di Bulis

commentary

A number of other uninscribed stele have been found in the necropolis, but this is the only funerary inscription from ancient Mylai to date, and parallels in the Euboean alphabet in the region are rare.

bibliography

  • Ollà Ravesi Sardella Zavettieri 2025 48 fig.40
  • Boffa 2025 608-621, figs. 1-2.

The script employs the Euboean alphabet
